scope: Registry initialization error propagation and selected profile ownership; no kernel runtime approval.

patch.validation: Targeted profile fault controls and complete original lifecycle/fault sweep required; no runtime admission.
patch.semantics: Propagate original RmInitRegistry failure from osRmInitRm; verify the original derived RMNvLinkControl force-disable write and readback, destroy the admitted profile registry on that later error. Profile helper owns cold-registry initial rollback; do not clear preexisting global registry on preflight refusal.

original_failure_path.before: RmInitRegistry return was ignored; selected-profile failure could continue RM construction.
original_failure_path.after: Initial status returned before later RM initialization. Profile helper destroys only its admitted initiallyempty registry on failed write/readback.
original_failure_path.caller: sysConstruct_IMPL checks osRmInitRm status and uses original failed-construction cleanup. Global facade subsequently invokes original RmShutdownRm to release portable/global state.
original_failure_path.derived_nvlink_failure: After successful profile admission, original RMNvLinkControl conversion failure/mismatch destroys original registry and returns failure. Original parent teardown remains responsible for remaining global objects.
original_failure_path.entry_cold_preflight: The project global lifecycle now checks actual original registry emptiness before coreInitializeRm, so a preexisting epoch never enters the original failure/shutdown path.
original_failure_path.cleanup_report: Failure and successful shutdown now use the same complete standalone Host allocation, invalid/unavailable and crypto cleanup predicate.

registry_original_stage_overlay.scope: Only exact initial registry status and derived NVLink stage statements, not the full osRmInitRm body.

targeted_controls.local_clang_18: All three controls passed ordinary and fatal address,undefined,function sanitizers.
targeted_controls.full_original_global_lifecycle_and_alloc: Separate combined checked-original-source control required; not replaced by targeted fixtures.

host_domains.result: passed ordinary and fatal address,undefined,function sanitizers locally

composed_source_authority: CHECKED-INTEGRATION-AUDIT.json maintained by combined builder, not this single-overlay record.
allocation_ownership_contract: Actual host pointers now carry original/external domains. Original Os and NVLink allocation/frees use original-domain APIs; bootstrap context/timer/firmware use external APIs. Global cleanup requires original-domain empty without freeing external identities; outer HostShutdown requires all domains empty.
